_comment: Proposed patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt field names to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying.

nodes.label: ECC (affaan-m/ECC)
nodes.summary: Agent harness performance optimization system: ~67 agents, ~282 skills, hooks runtime, rules packs, memory subsystem, AgentShield security. Multi-harness (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed, Kimi, Qwen, Hermes, OpenClaw, CodeBuddy, JoyCode, Copilot). MIT.

nodes.label: Verifier-gated self-improvement loop
nodes.summary: observation -> proposal -> verification -> promotion -> rollback. Promote playbooks only after a verifier proves improvement on a scenario without widening blast radius. Store every proposal as trace + artifact. Never auto-mutate harness config without verifier evidence. Negative-test the improver with regression fixtures.

nodes.label: Bounded evaluation + rollback loop
nodes.summary: Self-modification attempts run sandboxed and are reversible by construction (ecc2, Rust). Bounded: limited scope, explicit rollback path.

nodes.label: Layered persistent agent memory
nodes.summary: Optimize the context window, persist everything else. Session summaries (save/resume), continuous learning, instincts, retention feedback loop, cross-harness Unified Memory Vault keyed by ECC_AGENT_DATA_HOME.

nodes.label: Skill induction from repeated wins
nodes.summary: Repeated successful trajectories crystallize into reusable skills/workflows; skills are the canonical workflow surface, commands demoted to shims.

nodes.label: Context/token economics
nodes.summary: Model routing (Haiku subagents, Sonnet default, Opus for hard reasoning), MAX_THINKING_TOKENS cap 10k, subagents as context firewalls, strategic compaction at logical breakpoints, <10 MCP servers per project, /clear between unrelated tasks.

nodes.label: Fresh-context self-review
nodes.summary: Review agent work from a separate context window (dedicated reviewer agent) to avoid anchoring on the generator's reasoning. Generation and evaluation must not share context.

nodes.label: Hooks-based behavioral enforcement
nodes.summary: Enforce TDD/security/workflow gates at runtime via hooks, not prompt instructions. Delegation Completion Contract defines 'done' for delegated subtasks with completion evidence.

nodes.label: Human plan-approval gate (Plan Canvas)
nodes.summary: Agent plan -> loopback browser canvas -> human clicks/annotates -> Approve/Request changes maps onto planner CONFIRM gate. Harness-agnostic JSON CLI. Humans approve by pointing, not retyping.

nodes.label: Agent supply-chain security (AgentShield)
nodes.summary: Scan prompts, hooks, MCP configs, permissions, secrets, agent files. Policy packs, SARIF output, prompt-injection regression corpus, MCP package provenance, minimal default connector surface.

nodes.label: Honest multi-harness adapter matrix
nodes.summary: Publish per-harness capability/compliance matrix instead of claiming feature parity; adapter boundaries over core-domain logic; gitagent format for cross-harness portability.

nodes.label: stanford-iris-lab/meta-harness
nodes.summary: Automated search over harness design: what to store, retrieve, and show at each step.

nodes.label: greyhaven-ai/autocontext
nodes.summary: Recursive harness improvement loop using traces, reports, playbooks, and role-separated evaluators.

nodes.label: NousResearch/hermes-agent
nodes.summary: Self-improving operator shell: memories, skills, scheduler, gateways, subagents.

nodes.label: superset-sh/superset
nodes.summary: Parallel agent workspace with worktree isolation and diff review.

nodes.label: standardagents/dmux
nodes.summary: Tmux/worktree orchestration, lifecycle hooks, smart merging.

nodes.label: jarrodwatts/claude-hud
nodes.summary: Always-visible statusline: context, tools, agents, todos.

nodes.label: aidenybai/ghast
nodes.summary: Native macOS terminal multiplexer with cwd-grouped workspaces.
